en-US.name: pixelfx
en-US.summary: Skill for making pixel-art effects with the pixelfx code library. The catalog path is skills/pixelfx; the effect library and Node tools live in the same MIT repo and must be checked out separately. gallery/fonts is not covered by the repo MIT license and is outside this install path. Optional pch CLI install uses a remote script and needs operator review.
en-US.description: Pinned at 5294518ce7c72e48b6100a744596e0acf57f2826. Root LICENSE is MIT; NOTICE.md must travel with the skill path. Two docs/ files over 1 MiB are outside the skill install path.

zh-CN.name: pixelfx 像素特效
zh-CN.summary: 用 pixelfx 代码库制作像素特效的技能。目录安装路径为 skills/pixelfx；特效库和 Node 工具在同一 MIT 仓库中，需另行检出。gallery/fonts 不受仓库 MIT 许可覆盖，也不在本安装路径内。可选的 pch CLI 通过远程脚本安装，需操作者自行审核。
zh-CN.description: 固定版本 5294518ce7c72e48b6100a744596e0acf57f2826。根 LICENSE 为 MIT；NOTICE.md 须随技能路径携带。docs/ 中两个超过 1 MiB 的文件不在技能安装路径内。

requirements.value: The skill instructs working in a full pixelfx checkout with Node.js 18+; ffmpeg is optional for GIF/MP4 previews. This market path only includes skills/pixelfx plus root LICENSE/NOTICE.

NOTICE.md records MIT-adapted third-party code and states that the font in gallery/fonts is not covered by this repository's MIT license. Optional installation of the pch CLI uses a remote script (`curl | sh` or PowerShell); review that script and obtain approval before running it.
